title: Unique continuation of ordinary adic middle-extension sections
statement: Fix the finite-field and coefficient datum of [def-wf-middle-extension], a prime l different from the characteristic, and an algebraic closure Ω of Q_l in the finite-extension adic convention. Let C₀ be a separated finite-type smooth geometrically connected curve over the finite field, with dense open j₀:U₀→C₀, and let F be any lisse Ω-adic sheaf on the geometric open U. Let C and j:U→C be the geometric base changes, and let j_*F be the actual ordinary image in the intrinsic common-stage category of [lem-a1-adic-middle-extension-constructible], placed in degree zero. For every nonempty open V of C, restriction is injective on sections from the coefficient unit: if s:1_C→j_*F restricts to zero on V, then s=0. Sections and restriction are exactly A1ConstructibleSections and a1ConstructibleSectionRestriction of [lem-a1-constructible-degree-zero-proper-support], using the normalized completed pullback and unit isomorphism. No affineness, compact support, or Weil structure on F or s is required.

proof.text: The geometric curve is smooth, geometrically connected, separated and of finite type over the algebraically closed geometric field. Hence it is integral and Noetherian. The projection to the arithmetic curve is open, so the inverse image U of its dense lisse open is dense. A nonempty open V therefore meets U. The open U is connected, Noetherian and separated, and l is invertible on it.

proof.text: For the ordinary sheaf direct image, global sections of j_*F on C are precisely sections of F on U, at every finite coefficient level. Restrict the given section to U. Choose a geometric point in the nonempty intersection U and V. Its fibre vanishes because restriction to V vanishes. The geometric fibre functor on the connected lisse category is faithful, so this section on U is zero. The ordinary direct-image section formula then makes the original section zero. This argument also covers the zero sheaf and rank zero.

proof.text: Apply this argument to the actual common-stage arrow from the coefficient unit to adicMiddleExtensionObject. Represent its source, target and arrow at a common finite coefficient extension. The target is the degree-zero derived image of the ordinary pushforward of the realized lisse completed module. The normalized completed-system equivalence identifies the realized lisse inverse systems with completed module sheaves. Full faithfulness of the degree-zero embedding identifies its Hom group with the ordinary module Hom group. The immersion pullback comparison identifies the recorded restriction with ordinary restriction, including the unit comparison. After clearing uniformizer denominators, injectivity is the levelwise statement of the preceding step for integral inverse systems; equality of all components is equality of systems. The Hom tensor formula of the intrinsic rationalization, and flatness of localization, preserve this injectivity. The actual finite scalar transitions preserve the completed lisse systems and their ordinary-image comparisons by the normalized coefficient extension.  Passing to a common further coefficient field and to the directed colimit of Hom groups preserves the resulting equality. Thus zero under a1ConstructibleSectionRestriction implies zero in exactly A1ConstructibleSections, without any Weil invariance on the section.

lean.statement:
theorem adicMiddleExtension_section_eq_zero_of_restriction
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    (Ω : Type (u + 1)) [Field Ω] [Algebra ℚ_[l] Ω] [IsAlgClosure ℚ_[l] Ω]
    (c : MiddleExtensionCurve D)
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 c.C.hom] [GeometricallyConnected c.C.hom]
    [IsSeparated ((D.geometricFiber c.C).left ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    (F : adicMiddleExtensionLisse l Ω c hl)
    (V : (D.geometricFiber c.C).left.Opens)
    (hV : (V : Set (D.geometricFiber c.C).left).Nonempty) :
    ∀ s : A1ConstructibleSections l D hl Ω (D.geometricFiber c.C).left
      (adicMiddleExtensionObject l Ω c hl F),
      a1ConstructibleSectionRestriction l D hl Ω (D.geometricFiber c.C).left V s = 0 →
        s = 0
